summary: An authenticated SVG floor-planning workspace for Lumen Layouts where users create durable plans, place and edit fixtures, undo and redo workspace edits, switch between saved plans, export a summary, and print it.

journeys.title: A signed-in user creates, edits, saves, and reloads a floor plan

steps.action: open the workspace route while signed out
steps.expect: a sign-in panel is visible and the canvas is not visible

steps.action: sign in or create an account with email and password
steps.expect: the workspace canvas, plan toolbar, fixture library panel, and inspector panel are visible
the plan title displays Atrium Lighting Plan and an empty SVG canvas is visible

steps.action: drag a fixture from the library onto the canvas
steps.expect: a Pendant Light fixture appears on the SVG canvas and is selected

steps.action: edit the selected fixture in the inspector
steps.expect: the selected fixture moves to x 240 and y 160, shows rotation 45 degrees, and displays brightness 70%
a visible Saved status appears for Atrium Lighting Plan
Atrium Lighting Plan reloads with the Pendant Light still at x 240, y 160, rotation 45 degrees, and brightness 70%

acceptance: a saved plan name is still visible after a full page reload
a saved fixture position, rotation, and brightness are still visible after a full page reload

journeys.title: A user controls the canvas and fixtures with keyboard alternatives

steps.expect: the saved Atrium Lighting Plan and its SVG canvas are visible

steps.action: focus the SVG canvas with the keyboard
steps.expect: a visible focus outline and keyboard shortcut help are shown on the canvas

steps.action: zoom and pan the canvas using keyboard controls
steps.expect: the zoom indicator reads 125% and the pan coordinates read x 40 and y 20

steps.action: select the existing fixture using keyboard navigation
steps.expect: the Pendant Light is selected and the inspector shows its fields

steps.action: move the selected fixture using keyboard controls
steps.expect: the inspector displays x 260 and y 180 and the fixture position visibly changes on the canvas

acceptance: the canvas can receive keyboard focus
keyboard pan and zoom changes are visible without using a mouse
a selected fixture can be moved with keyboard controls

journeys.title: A user undoes and redoes a fixture edit

steps.expect: Atrium Lighting Plan is visible with the Pendant Light selected or selectable
the inspector shows the Pendant Light fixture details
the inspector displays brightness 35% and the fixture appears dimmer
the brightness returns to its previous visible value
the inspector again displays brightness 35% and the fixture appears dimmer

acceptance: undo restores the prior visible fixture value
redo reapplies the undone fixture value

journeys.title: A user creates a second plan and switches between saved plans

steps.expect: the plan switcher shows Atrium Lighting Plan
Gallery Track Plan becomes the active plan with an empty canvas

steps.action: switch back to the first plan
steps.expect: Atrium Lighting Plan becomes active and its Pendant Light fixture is visible
Gallery Track Plan becomes active and its canvas is empty

acceptance: switching plans changes the active plan title
fixtures from one plan do not appear on another plan

journeys.title: A user views the fixture library route

steps.expect: the fixture library page is visible
Pendant Light, Wall Sconce, Floor Lamp, and Recessed Downlight options are visible

acceptance: the separate library route displays reusable fixture options

journeys.title: A user exports and prints a plan summary

steps.expect: a reports page with a plan selector is visible

steps.action: select the saved plan for reporting
steps.expect: the report preview shows Atrium Lighting Plan and includes the Pendant Light fixture
a downloadable summary file is produced with the plan name and fixture count visible in the file content or download label
a print-ready summary view or print dialog trigger is shown with Atrium Lighting Plan in the printable content

acceptance: the report preview includes the selected plan name
export produces an observable downloadable plan summary
print produces an observable print-ready plan summary

journeys.title: A user opens settings and verifies account boundary behavior

steps.expect: the settings page displays the signed-in account email and a sign-out control
the signed-out home or sign-in screen is visible

steps.action: open the workspace route while signed out
steps.expect: the sign-in panel is visible and no saved plan data is shown

acceptance: signed-out visitors cannot see saved workspace plans

routes.name: Home
routes.purpose: public Lumen Layouts landing page with navigation to sign in and workspace

routes.name: Workspace
routes.purpose: authenticated SVG planning canvas with plan controls, library panel, inspector, undo, redo, pan, zoom, save, and plan switching

routes.name: Library
routes.purpose: fixture library reference page showing the available draggable fixture types

routes.name: Reports
routes.purpose: authenticated report preview, export, and print page for saved plans

routes.name: Settings
routes.purpose: authenticated account settings page with signed-in account display and sign-out control

entities.name: authSession
relationships: an auth session represents the currently signed-in backend SDK user and is not persisted as an application database row

entities.name: plan
relationships: a plan belongs to one signed-in user

entities.name: fixture
relationships: a fixture belongs to one plan
a fixture belongs to one signed-in user through its plan

auth.model: email + password via the backend SDK
rules: workspace, reports, and settings routes require a signed-in user
a signed-out visitor sees a sign-in prompt instead of saved plans
a signed-in user only sees plans and fixtures they own
signing out hides all user-owned workspace and report data until another valid sign-in

operations.description: authenticate a visitor using auth.signIn or auth.signUp from the backend SDK and show the authenticated workspace state

responsibilities.behavior: establish a visible signed-in session for the supplied email and password using the backend SDK without storing the password in application data

operations.description: end the current authenticated session using auth.signOut from the backend SDK and hide user-owned application data

responsibilities.behavior: clear the visible authenticated session and return protected routes to the sign-in state

operations.description: create a user-owned floor plan via db.entity('plan').create

responsibilities.behavior: generate a planId and initialize viewportPanX to 0, viewportPanY to 0, viewportZoom to 1, and savedAt to a visible initial saved timestamp

operations.description: persist pan and zoom values for the active plan via db.entity('plan').update
create a fixture instance for the active plan via db.entity('fixture').create

responsibilities.behavior: generate a fixtureId and initialize dropped fixture values for x, y, rotation, brightness, and zIndex

operations.description: persist fixture inspector edits via db.entity('fixture').update
mark the active plan as saved and show a saved status via db.entity('plan').update

responsibilities.behavior: set savedAt to the current save timestamp for the active plan

operations.description: restore the previous visible fixture workspace value from the in-session undo history

responsibilities.behavior: restore the prior in-session fixture values for the selected fixture and make the reverted values visible

operations.description: reapply the next visible fixture workspace value from the in-session redo history

responsibilities.behavior: reapply the next in-session fixture values for the selected fixture and make the redone values visible

operations.description: produce a downloadable plan summary for the selected plan

responsibilities.behavior: generate a downloadable summary containing the selected plan name, fixture count, and fixture details

operations.description: produce a print-ready plan summary for the selected plan

responsibilities.behavior: render a print-ready summary containing the selected plan name, fixture count, and fixture details

states.loading: loading indicator while sign-in or account creation is in progress
states.empty: email and password fields are visible for a signed-out visitor
states.validation: email must look like an email and password is required
states.success: workspace canvas is visible after authentication

states.loading: loading indicator while plans and fixtures load
states.empty: empty canvas message prompting the user to drag a fixture from the library
states.validation: plan name is required and fixture brightness must be between 0 and 100
states.success: Saved status with the active plan name

states.loading: canvas skeleton while active plan fixtures load
states.empty: no fixtures yet message inside the canvas
states.validation: position fields require numeric x and y values
states.success: selected fixture outline and updated inspector values

states.loading: loading indicator while report data loads
states.validation: select a plan before exporting or printing
states.success: report preview, downloadable export result, or print-ready result

states.loading: loading indicator while account data loads
states.empty: signed-out prompt when no account is active
states.validation: account email must be present for a signed-in session

acceptance.statement: a signed-out visitor opening /workspace sees a sign-in panel and cannot see saved plan data
after authentication, the workspace canvas, plan toolbar, fixture library panel, and inspector panel are visible
creating a plan displays the entered plan name as the active plan title
a fixture dragged from the library appears on the SVG canvas and becomes selectable
inspector edits to fixture x, y, rotation, and brightness are visible on the selected fixture
a saved plan and fixture values are readable after a full page reload
keyboard controls visibly change canvas pan and zoom
undo and redo controls visibly restore and reapply a fixture brightness change
switching plans changes which fixtures are visible on the canvas
exporting a report produces an observable downloadable summary for the selected plan
printing a report shows a print-ready summary containing the selected plan name
after sign-out, opening /workspace shows the sign-in panel and no saved plan data

deferred.reason: the request requires user-owned durable plans, not simultaneous collaboration

deferred.item: photorealistic rendering or CAD file import
deferred.reason: the request specifies an interactive SVG floor-planning workspace
export is implemented as a local downloadable summary using the existing application capabilities
